turns.text: Hey Lloyd, did the GPU cluster health check finish? I'm getting weird latency on node 4.
The check completed with one warning on node 4 regarding thermal throttling, but it's within operational limits. No errors found.
Okay, good. Also, I'm trying to estimate the budget for our new reinforcement learning project. We are setting up the Offline-to-Online RL Pipeline.
Noted. Do you have historical usage data from similar projects to extrapolate from?
Not really. The total GPU-hour cost for a full 5-stage pipeline on a single task is currently unknown. We haven't run the full thing end-to-end yet.
Understood. Without historical data, we'll need to run a pilot or use theoretical estimates for the 5-stage workflow.
Right. Anyway, I also ordered a new mechanical keyboard. It should arrive Tuesday.
Great choice. I'll mark the expected delivery date on your calendar.
